title: Generate character sheets, props, and environment reference images first, then…
content:
Generate character sheets, props, and environment reference images first, then reuse them as omni-reference inputs in Seedance 2.0 to maintain visual consistency across shots  
If ChatGPT-generated character faces look generic, reuse the original character prompts and revise the character sheets (e.g., via Grok) with more realistic faces before generating Seedance shots  
Create detailed scene-by-scene cinematic shot sheets (camera angles, transitions, pacing, continuity bridges) and use them as scene-based prompts in Seedance 2.0 for final shot generation  
When generating final shots in Seedance 2.0, use omni-reference plus character-consistency prompting to keep the same characters consistent across scenes  
If long Seedance generations produce artifacting or black-and-white noise, regenerate/fix the affected shots before assembling the sequence

Al generar tomas finales en Seedance 2.0, utiliza omni-referencia más prompts de consistencia de personajes para mantener los mismos personajes consistentes a lo largo de las escenas.  
Si las generaciones largas de Seedance producen artefactos o ruido en blanco y negro, regenera/arregla las tomas afectadas antes de ensamblar la secuencia.

在Seedance 2.0中生成最终镜头时，使用全方位参考加上角色一致性提示，以保持同一角色在不同场景中的一致性。  
如果长时间的Seedance生成出现伪影或黑白噪声，在组装序列之前重新生成/修复受影响的镜头。
